mode_help: auto = GREEN stories publish automatically, AMBER ones become Metricool drafts. review = every post becomes a Metricool draft for Geoffry.
repo_help: SportsWire lives in the sportswire/ folder of the ply-media repo (decided by Geoffry, 19 Oct 2026). Never touch anything outside sportswire/.

lb.timezone_note: Metricool brand timezone is Asia/Nicosia (same clock as Beirut); card text says "Beirut time" for Lebanese kick-offs.

lb.why: Geoffry, 23 Oct 2026: cover the top 20 Lebanese sports, post more often, Stories and posts

cy.why: Geoffry, 23 Oct 2026: "let's do the same for cyprus"

slots.explained: 12:30 the day before an A event (both pages, max 2 a week); evergreen on Tuesday 12:30
slots.features: 18:00 Tuesday and Thursday (both pages): people and community stories
slots.round_wrap: from 22:30 the evening the round completes (last game ending by about 21:30), otherwise the first free slot from 10:00 the next morning

rhythm.slots_note: From Metricool best-time data on 21 Oct 2026: weekday peak 10:00-12:00 and a second peak at 18:00; weekends about half the volume with peaks at 10:00 and 18:00-19:00. The weekly desk re-checks getBestTimeToPostByNetwork once each page has two weeks of its own data.
rhythm.trial_reels: off until the page has 1,000 followers (Instagram requirement); then 2 a week to test hooks

story_slots_lb.today: 09:30 (every day with an event in any top-20 sport)
story_slots_lb.predict: with Today, for each A match, plus one per league round for its biggest game (max 3 a day)
story_slots_lb.quiz: 13:30 Mon, Wed, Sat (question, then the answer 2 minutes later)
story_slots_lb.main_post: the day's main post as a Story card, 30 minutes after it goes out
story_slots_lb.round_card: 09:30 on the first day of each round, one per league (top two leagues; PLAYBOOK 6, League rounds)
story_slots_lb.score_updates: after each league game or group of games, posted by its result desk (the round card again with the finals filled in)
story_slots_lb.highlights: one per league; Geoffry adds the round's Stories by hand (the brief lists them)

story_slots_cy.today: 09:30 (every day with an event in any top-20 sport)
story_slots_cy.predict: with Today, for each A match, plus one per league round for its biggest game (max 3 a day)
story_slots_cy.quiz: 13:30 Mon, Wed, Sat (question, then the answer 2 minutes later)
story_slots_cy.main_post: the day's main post as a Story card, 30 minutes after it goes out
story_slots_cy.round_card: 09:30 on the first day of each round, one per league (top two leagues; PLAYBOOK 6, League rounds)
story_slots_cy.score_updates: after each league game or group of games, posted by its result desk (the round card again with the finals filled in)
story_slots_cy.highlights: one per league; Geoffry adds the round's Stories by hand (the brief lists them)

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.dm: the weekly desk picks the subjects for the week after next and writes three questions; Geoffry sends the DMs; answers go in series/answers/ (verbatim) and make the post AMBER

explained.name: Explained
explained.when: 12:30 the day before an A event; evergreen on Tuesday 12:30 in a week without one

sports_maps.every_run: python3 tools/sweep.py today --page <lb|cy> (all top-20 sports, in order) and python3 tools/sweep.py coverage --page <lb|cy>

league_rounds.help: Domestic league games go in Stories (round card, score updates, predict) and one round wrap carousel per league after the round; only A games (derbies, etc.) get their own feed result. Geoffry, 24 Oct 2026. PLAYBOOK 6, League rounds.
league_rounds.other_leagues: round results in the Stories and the Monday 'other sports this weekend' carousel

global_sport: off: no global sport without a Lebanese or Cypriot athlete, coach or club in the story (Geoffry, 24 Oct 2026; PLAYBOOK 2)
money: on hold until further notice: no sponsorship, sponsorship platform, media kit or paid-deal work (Geoffry, 24 Oct 2026; CAMPAIGN 9)
